articles.title: Alchemy's AI-driven identity and payment service gains access to Visa network
articles.snippet: The AgentCard integration with Visa Intelligent Commerce allows AI agents built on models from any provider, including OpenAI or Anthropic, to effect commercial transactions.

articles.title: Philippine SEC signals readiness for RWA tokenization
articles.snippet: Philippine SEC Commissioner Rogelio Quevedo told Cointelegraph that tokenized assets could give Filipinos more legitimate investment options while helping steer them away from scams.

articles.title: Inception Labs' Mercury 2 AI Beats Google's DiffusionGemma at Its Own Game
articles.snippet: Both models trade word-by-word generation for parallel denoising. Only one of them does it without losing intelligence in the trade.
